The '''BAF-616 Construction Droid''' was a large six-legged model of [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droid]] that was produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. BAF-616 Construction Droids were repurposed to support [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in their defense of the factory near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
